summary_en: Completion of acquisition of all equity interests in Framochem Francia-Magyar Finomkemiai Kft (Hungary-based fine chemicals company). Quota purchase agreement signed 27 Mar 2026; closing completed 25 Aug 2026. Target becomes wholly owned subsidiary. Financial impact on FY3/27 results under review.
summary_jp: ハンガリーのFramochem Francia-Magyar Finomkemiai Kft社の全持分取得完了。2026年3月27日に持分譲渡契約（Quota Purchase Agreement）締結、8月25日クロージング完了。同社は当社完全子会社化。FY3/27業績への影響は現在精査中。
